body: From the DM-272 review (orchestrator, this run): Fireguard's AST gate counts only expect() calls inside each `it` callback; tests that assert only through a helper are flagged empty-test and fail the gate before mutation/flake run. src/core/repo/scorecardPortability.test.ts (DM-269, on space-sprint-1) has ~25 tests of that shape — fix them (have the helper return the value and assert in the callback) when you run Fireguard; check the whole epic's test files for the same pattern (grep for `it(` callbacks without `expect(`).
